caption: The drawing depicts a lidded goblet or decorative container, made of what appears to be a reflective material, likely metal or glass. The object consists of a rounded body set atop a broad, circular pedestal base that flares outward. The lid is dome-shaped with a pronounced finial or knob at the top, also reflecting light. Both the lid and the body of the vessel feature engraved or etched floral and grapevine patterns, including leaves, flowers, and clusters of grapes. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale, showing a range of values from light highlights to dark shadows, with a clear focus on the reflective qualities and intricate details of the object. The background is plain, and the vessel is centered within a rectangular border on a sheet of slightly yellowed paper. The artist's signature, "JOHN PARENTINO," appears in the lower left corner.
title: Sugar Bowl
